'''2012 US Nationals Day 1 Marc Hanson LS Rescue The Princess''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Marc Hanson]] at [[2012 US Nationals]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Rescue The Princess / Sometimes I Amaze Even Myself]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
